one_line: A seasonal POV line in the first frame over simple top-down hands: box, pieces, finished model.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 high-angle wide of five green kit boxes on a floor, a child's hands at the edge. No speech. Text from frame one: "POV:" "מצאת את הפעילות המושלמת לעשות עם הילדים בסוכה". 0:01 adult hands hold the flamingo box.
q1_hook.why: A seasonal, specific line (what to do with the kids in the sukkah) gives a reason in the first frame (H1, T3, K7), and the pack art shows by 0:01 (S1, H2). With no voice or face the hook lives only on screen, in small type near the top edge (H4, H6, T4).

beats.what: Five green boxes in a row, then adult hands hold and open the flamingo box; the POV text
beats.why: A holiday reason and the product at once

beats.what: Hands unfold the illustrated instruction sheet
Hands pour bags of pink bricks into a bowl; a macro close-up of one brick
After a cut, the finished flamingo is turned in a hand against a wooden table
beats.why: The build is skipped, the result arrives fast

beats.what: The flamingo stands on a dark stand at a desk edge; hands adjust its legs

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, save or share ask in the video or the caption.
q2_flow.why: A new shot every 1 to 3 s and a result reveal at 0:08 keep a 17 s Reel moving (R3, R4). Skipping the build avoids dead air (R1) but leaves out the step parents care about. At 17 s it ends right on the finished model (R2, E8).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption, last line: "אפשר להשיג אותה בחנויות יצירה וחנויות לילדים" (where to find it). No link, price, comment word or ask.
q3_cta.why: A where-to-buy line in the last caption line, with nothing said or shown at the end of the video, is easy to miss (C6). It avoids bait (C1, C2), but a seasonal idea could earn a send to a parent planning the holiday if it asked (C4, R5).

q4_shown.what: The kit range on a floor at 0:00; the flamingo box with "105 חלקים" at 0:01; the opened box, instruction sheet, pink bricks poured into a bowl, a macro brick; then the finished flamingo held, turned, displayed. No child builds it. No price.
q4_shown.why: Hands-only handling carries the Reel without a face (S4), and the finished flamingo is an eye-catching result. The building is skipped and no child is seen with it, so "with the kids" is claimed but never shown (S6).

q5_edit.what: About 7 shots in 17 s (first pass), about 2.4 s each, straight cuts. The build is skipped: a cut goes from pouring bricks to the finished model. One macro close-up at 0:07. No speed changes. Title about 3 s. Ends on a static shot.
q5_edit.why: Cuts of 1 to 3 s keep it quick (E2, R3). With no voice and one short title, the message is almost only visual (E4, T1). It ends on the finished model with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A seasonal craft idea: a pink flamingo brick kit as an activity for children in the sukkah; it serves parents planning holiday time with the kids.
q6_topic.why: A holiday is a real moment when parents look for something to do (K7, K6). The calm unboxing carries little feeling and no story, so no emotional peak (K1, K2).

q7_filmed.what: Top-down handheld close-ups of an adult's hands over a wooden slat table in daylight; a high-angle wide at the start; a macro close-up; a static eye-level shot of the finished model at a desk edge. No face; a child's hand only at 0:00.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the builder's seat (F5, S4), and boxes, bricks and the model fill the frame (F4, F8). Daylight and a plain table look homemade and sharp (F7). The title crosses the box row at the top edge (F2, T4).

q8_text.on_screen: One small white bold title with a dark outline, centred in the upper part of the frame (about 16 to 25% down), from 0:00 to about 0:02: "POV:", then "מצאת את הפעילות המושלמת" and "לעשות עם הילדים בסוכה". No other text: no subtitles, no brand overlay, no price.
q8_text.caption: "פעילות חמודה, קלילה ושימושית גם לאחר כך 🥰". About 22 words in 3 lines: the product ("ערכה של סופרקיט") and where to buy, with emoji. No hashtags, no CTA, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: The title names topic and occasion at once (T3), but it is small, near the top edge, gone after about 3 s, and its first line is English (T4, T5, T6). The caption names the product and where to buy in plain words (T7), with no hashtags and no disclosure (T8, S7).

weak_points: The sukkah and kids claim is never shown; the build is skipped; text small, brief and at the top edge; no voice, no price, no ask; no disclosure for the superkitcraft collaboration.
lumebook_takeaway: Put a holiday POV line on screen at 0:00, then film hands only: the box, one page, the finished spread, on a table with the phone overhead.
not_verified: Music (not established; the transcript is "תודה רבה" only); whether the Reel is paid (coauthor superkitcraft, no label); who the creator is; the table is not shown to be a sukkah. Correction to src/coded: the title is visible 0:00 to about 0:02 and gone by 0:03, not about 5 s. Cut count from the first pass.
